title: record:quick_actions draws an action's spec variant through the Button primitive unmapped, so `danger` (归档 / 删除) renders unstyled and `primary` as default, unlike the header and the row menu
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2916 dev report (cloud PR #3035, report `6254151626`), out-of-scope finding 1 / open question Q1. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What a user sees (measured)

The environment page's 「设置」 tab, built under ruling A on objectstack-ai/cloud#3001 (`6247273688`, the maintainer's confirmed design: the danger zone's buttons are red), was read on a local stack at objectui `43efd078`, Chromium, zh-CN.
- 归档 and 删除 (spec `variant: 'danger'`) draw as unstyled buttons: no `bg-` and no `border` class in the DOM.
- The same actions draw red in the record header and in the list row menu.
- The block's own `variant: 'destructive'` does not reach them.

## Why (objectui `43efd078`)

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-quick-actions.tsx:341` passes `variant={(action as any).variant || schema.variant || 'default'}` to `Button`.
- The `Button` primitive (`packages/components/src/ui/button.tsx`) knows `default / destructive / outline / secondary / ghost / link`. The spec's action vocabulary is `primary / secondary / danger / ghost / link`, and its doc says "danger = destructive" (`ActionSchema.variant`).
- The header maps it: `containers.tsx:2039` `isDestructiveAction` reads `danger`. This block does not, so `danger` and `primary` fall through to an unstyled button, and a per-action variant beats the block's `destructive`.

## Target

`record:quick_actions` maps an action's spec variant the way the header and the row menu do:
- `danger` → `destructive`;
- `primary` → `default`;
- the block's `variant` stays the fallback for an action that declares none.

No spec change and no new key. One renderer, honouring a declared variant.

## Acceptance

1. A test: a `record:quick_actions` block with a `danger` action draws the destructive style, a `primary` action draws the default (filled) style, and an action with no variant takes the block's `variant`.
2. The 「设置」 tab's 归档 / 删除 draw red at the next objectui pin in cloud (the PM reads it).

## Dedupe

Searched for: `quick_actions danger variant`, `record_section destructive button`, `action variant Button vocabulary`. objectstack-ai/objectui#12764 (the header's destructive band) is the header's half and is closed.
